name: Baked Striped Bass (Or White Fish)
description: A whole striped bass or white fish baked with garlic, mushrooms, and herbs, served with a rich butter sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 to 4 lb whole striped bass, dressed and boned

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and lightly butter a large, shallow baking pan.
Wash and pat dry the fish with paper towels. Sprinkle inside and outside with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in the baking pan and add the remaining ingredients except for the sauce ingredients.
Bake, basting frequently with the liquid in the pan, for 40 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully remove the fish to a heated serving platter, cover, and keep warm.
To make the sauce, cook the pan liquid over medium heat until it reduces to 1 cup, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend 1 teaspoon of butter with flour and stir into the hot liquid. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and add the remaining butter, shaking the pan until melted. Remove from heat.
Serve the sauce with the fish.

keywords: baked fish, striped bass, white fish, herb butter sauce

_similar.name: Dad's Spaghetti
_similar.description: A comforting spaghetti dish with bacon, mushrooms, and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 tsp garlic salt or 1 to 2 minced garlic cloves

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti, drain, and set aside.
Brown bacon in a frying pan with garlic salt or minced garlic.
Remove bacon and most of the grease from the pan.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until tender.
Return bacon to the pan and add mushroom soup.
Stir and heat the sauce through, adding cheese and enough water to achieve the desired consistency.
Combine the sauce with cooked spaghetti and serve.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti, bacon, mushroom sauce, creamy pasta

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper
